feat(effects): Effected — a per-cell colour effect over a renderable's finished cells (rich-effects-fxiy.3t3) (#286)

* feat(effects): Effected — a per-cell colour effect over a renderable's finished cells (rich-effects-fxiy.3t3)

src/renderables/effect.ts: Effect (cell colours, row/col/seed, t → colours)
and Effected, a Renderable that measures as its child. Segments are cut
only where colours change; unchanged cells keep their ColorSpec, so the
identity effect is byte-identical. Anchors shift per run, wide glyphs stay
whole, colours are built with ColorSpec.fromRgba. Seeds are FNV-1a of a
caller key and the cell position. docs/effects.md; demo in the colour
studio.

* fix(effects): an effect sees the colours on screen — reverse swapped, ANSI and default resolved through a TerminalTheme (rich-effects-fxiy.3t3)

Effected's `defaults: CellColors` becomes `theme: TerminalTheme`, the type
that already says what a terminal draws, so an ANSI-slot cell is moved from
the caller's red rather than the built-in table's. Colours are read through
Style.drawnColors, the one account of what a style writes, so alpha is
flattened as the wire flattens it. Under reverse the two slots are swapped
in and swapped back out. The studio's sweep counts its indent, and the docs
state the nesting law at the level it holds: colours, not bytes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(effects): resolve a cell at the depth it is written, and keep the written spec (rich-effects-fxiy.3t3)

An effect now sees drawnColors at the render's colour depth, so below
truecolor it starts from the colour on screen; and a slot it leaves alone
keeps that flattened spec, so a translucent glyph does not re-blend over a
ground the effect moved.
